policy: OneDrive and OneDriveTemp are explicitly released for dismantling on user request. Other confirmed work areas and app-managed paths remain protected. No delete/copy/exec: content moves to root categories or 07_待确认; empty OneDrive shells move to 07_待确认\空目录归档.
release_notes: OneDrive: dismantle; extract content into 06_旧备份, 03_图片 and 07_待确认.
OneDriveTemp: move whole old temp container to 07_待确认.
FileHistory and SteamLibrary are still protected; they are candidates for a future user-approved archival move, not touched in this run.
